lines.text: Frost patterns the window. A tired dad shuffles in, hair flattened.
He tips oats from the red Hearth Oats pack into a pot.
His sleepy daughter slumps at the table, chin propped on her fist.
Dad stirs, eyes closing. The spoon keeps going without him.
He sets a steaming bowl beside the red pack. She wakes, smiling.
She lifts a spoonful to his mouth. He accepts, eyes still shut.
Hearth Oats. Slow down, warm up.

writes.note: I drafted a short kitchen scene from your line, ending on the tagline.

reply.rationale: One location, six short beats with a gentle joke (the spoon-feeding dad) and the red pack on show, closing on the tagline as one spoken line; about 14.4 s by rule 10.
